description:
One change of a task's pass/fail rating; the `task:ratings` entry's fields. Every change is kept, and the latest
one for a task is its rating.

task.description: The task key whose rating changed.
task.title: Task

verdict.description: The rating the change sets; `cleared` drops it.
verdict.title: Verdict

time.description: When the change was made, in epoch seconds.
time.title: Time

reason.description: Why the task fails; empty when none was given.
reason.title: Reason

actor.description: Who made the change, as the write's actor names it; empty when none.
actor.title: Actor

session.description: The harness session that made the change, as its write named it; empty when none.
session.title: Session

harness.description: The harness of that session; empty when the write named none.
harness.title: Harness

title: RatingEvent
